artifact_observations.reasoning: The text at the top of the cover and on the background items is nonsensical and malformed, a common AI artifact where letterforms are approximated but not legible.
Slight smearing and 'melting' of textures where the character overlaps the background rack; edges lack the crisp ink lines typical of printed comics, appearing slightly digital/painterly.
The objects on the rack to the right lose structural coherence, blending into each other without clear boundaries.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly conveys the 'comic book' class through its iconic subject matter (Spider-Man), dynamic pose, and glossy aesthetic. However, it fails several strict checkpoints because the image is a tight crop that excludes the physical attributes of the object (staples, spine, full rectangular shape) and interior features (panels, speech bubbles). It aligns well with the *art style* but poorly with the *physical object definition* due to framing.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from noticeable AI generation artifacts, primarily illegible/gibberish text which breaks the immersion of a real product. Additionally, there are minor texture anomalies and edge bleeding between the foreground character and the background rack, indicating a lack of precise spatial separation and clean line work expected in high-quality print media.
